name: Shima Tetsurou
source:
A member of Homura's father team. Kaneda's best friend.

First-aid kit: he can cure some illnesses, such as poison or injuries/sprains.

[spoiler]He likes secretly Rikana that's why he looks Seijirou like his rival.[/spoiler]
